what_it_does: CXL (Compute Express Link) lets servers attach extra memory over a fast network fabric, but this extra memory is slower than on-chip DRAM. HybridTier is a system that automatically moves data between fast DRAM and slow CXL memory based on access patterns. The key innovation is tracking both long-term frequency (which data is accessed often) and short-term momentum (which data is being accessed right now), because both matter: data might be accessed frequently overall but not at this moment, or vice versa. The system uses probabilistic sampling to avoid the memory overhead of tracking every access, balancing accuracy against metadata cost.
